description: Read this account’s linked sportsbooks exactly as the app shows them: whether sportsbook linking is allowed, each account (accountId, book, region, betsSynced), its connection (verified, paused, reconnect_required, revoked, disabled, unknown), needsReconnect, its last check and last refresh, the newest bet import, and booksOnTickets: the books on the customer’s saved tickets (bookAbbr, tickets, lastSeenAt). Never contacts the sportsbook.
name: list_sportsbooks
title: List my sportsbooks
